description:
FILED s530a (Opus agent, 2026-10-31) as the residue of #3865.  PRE-EXISTING.

`local $h{@a}` (and `local $h{@a} = V`) keys on the ARRAY itself where perl keys on its COUNT -- the `local` element forms are lowered by the v1 TEXT seam (Pl/Parser.pm, the p-local-hash-elem / p-local-hash-elem-init sites near 2574, 3401, 4471-4483), which parses the subscript as a free-standing expression and never reaches ExprToCL's _hash_key_form, the one key rule #3865 fixed for the read, the store, exists and delete.

    my @a = (1,2); our %h = (2 => "two"); { local $h{@a} = "loc"; print "$h{2}\n"; }
  perl 5.40.3: loc        PCL (s530a): two        (emission: (p-local-hash-elem-init %h @a "loc"))
Probe scratch/s530a/pr/c3.pl row 2.  The natural owner is the codegen review's C2 (close the text seam one statement kind per session, `local` first): once `local` lowers through ExprToCL the key rule applies by construction; a fix in Parser.pm's text path would be a second copy of the rule (CLAUDE.md rule 11).


=== DONE (s530c) ===
FIXED by routing, not by a second copy of the rule: `Pl::Parser::_subscript_key_expr` (the v1 seam's key compile for every `local` element form) gains an ELEM flag -- set by the single-target caller for a one-group non-slice subscript and by the `local (LIST)` item caller for a `$`-sigiled one-group item -- and such a key is compiled through `_parse_expression_internal(..., as_key)` -> `ExprToCL::generate_hash_key` -> `_hash_key_form`, the #3865 rule (`p-scalar` around a bare array key).  Slices keep their LIST key; `delete local` is unchanged (its caller passes no ELEM).  The seam itself (C2) was not closed: the key now reaches the one rule through it.
Probe scratch/s530c/pr/loc1.pl (16 lines): `local $h{@a} = V`, `local $h{@a}`, `local $h{@$r}`, `local ($h{@a}, $b[0]) = ...`, `local $hr->{@a}`, the slice `local @h{@a}`, and the array forms `local $b[@a]` (already right) -- all identical to perl now (5 wrong before).  Guard Pl/t/local-elem-02.t L1 (inverse: fails on ff265320).  corpus-diff vs ff265320: nothing moved by this member.  ir-spec §4.1 "An ELEMENT's subscript is SCALAR context".
subject: `local $h{@a}` keys on the array, not its COUNT: the local element forms are lowered by the v1 text seam, which never reaches the #3865 key rule -- silent wrong
